title: Travel Agents: Taiwan — Player Aid
subtitle: One action per turn · then trim your Larder to 7

sections.heading: Do ONE action
lines: VISIT (here): flip 3 from this region's market — event fires by scope, keep 2 ingredients.
CONVENIENCE STORE (anywhere): flip 1 from any region — take the ingredient, or the event fires.
TRAVEL: move 1 region (HSR = 北↔南), flip 1 on arrival — take it (an event does nothing).
PROMOTE (here): put 2 Buzz on face-up vendor(s) — public, and your rival can pile on.
CLAIM A TICKET: take 1 from the row of 3, then refill. Scores into your piles later.

sections.heading: Bribe a vendor  (win it — one rule for all)
lines: Be with it + hold 2+ more Buzz than your rival + pay its ingredients minus your region-discount icons (Buzz never discounts).
Gain Prestige + Reputation + perk → clear ALL Buzz, refill, clock +1. FOOD has a discount icon; DRINKS none.

sections.heading: Events — the island living its life
lines: ⦿ YOU · ⬢ THIS REGION · ➤ NEXT DOOR (read from the drawn region). Hazards tax or delay — never destroy, never a whole turn.

sections.heading: Day → Night clock  (+1 each Bribe)
lines: DUSK (5th Bribe, 2p): judge daytime tickets, flip the day layer → night decks, swap the ticket row. Keep your Larder.
LAST TRAIN (10th, 2p): judge nighttime tickets, then finish the round + one more. Marks grow with player count.

sections.heading: Score once, at the end
lines: Tickets: +value in your 成團 WIN pile, less floor(value/2) in your 遺珠 LOSE pile. Most = TOP AGENT.
